narrations.title: The King's Parade
narrations.narration: Leo the lion stomped through the sunny meadow. Thump, wobble, thump! His teal velvet cape fluttered behind him, and his tiny golden paper crown sat crookedly between his ears. He stopped, crossed his arms over his chubby chest, and puffed out his cheeks.

narrations.title: The Tiny Witness
narrations.narration: Pip the mouse shivered inside his sunshine-yellow hoodie, his thick-rimmed teal spectacles sliding down his nose. He hid behind a large daisy, terrified but unable to stop watching the drama.

narrations.title: The Clever Rabbit
narrations.narration: Rosie the rabbit sighed, adjusting the strap of her lime-green utility satchel. She looked at Leo in her bright cyan tunic and smiled a clever smile.

narrations.title: A Challenge to the Crown
narrations.narration: Leo’s face twisted into a comically grumpy frown. He stomped his foot. Rosie added a mischievous glint to her eyes as she delivered the final blow.

narrations.title: The Face in the Well
narrations.narration: Fuming, Leo marched toward the well using high-kneed steps, wobbling as he went. When he reached the edge, he leaned over and looked deep into the water.

narrations.title: The Squeaky Echo
narrations.narration: Leo didn't realize it was his own reflection. He let out his biggest roar, only for the well to bounce back a squeaky echo.

narrations.title: The Retreat
narrations.narration: Terrified of his own shadow, Leo turned around and ran as fast as his round belly would allow, disappearing into the deep jungle to hide.

narrations.title: Peace Restored
narrations.narration: Pip cheered, jumping up and down. Rosie performed a grand 'ta-da' wave with both hands. The meadow was finally peaceful.
